amazon_custom_workflows_current_step_che.name: amazon_custom_workflows_current_step_check
amazon_custom_workflows_current_step_che.value: ("amazon_custom_workflows"."status" = 'completed' and "amazon_custom_workflows"."current_step_key" is null) or ("amazon_custom_workflows"."status" <> 'completed' and "amazon_custom_workflows"."current_step_key" in ('research_capture','research_review','product_plan','provisional_facts','seller_facts','customization_schema','spu_sku','design_proof','authorized_assets','studio_draft','studio_content','content_review','seller_central','online_qa'))

research_items_classification_evidence_p.name: research_items_classification_evidence_pair_check
research_items_classification_evidence_p.value: ("research_items"."classification_evidence_source" is null and "research_items"."classification_evidence_key" is null and "research_items"."classification_evidence_label" is null) or ("research_items"."classification_evidence_source" is not null and "research_items"."classification_evidence_key" is not null and "research_items"."classification_evidence_label" is not null)

research_items_product_type_pair_check.name: research_items_product_type_pair_check
research_items_product_type_pair_check.value: ("research_items"."classification_status" = 'unclassified' and "research_items"."product_type_name" is null and "research_items"."product_type_key" is null) or ("research_items"."classification_status" in ('suggested', 'confirmed') and "research_items"."product_type_name" is not null and "research_items"."product_type_key" is not null)

product_plans_cost_check.name: product_plans_cost_check
product_plans_cost_check.value: ("product_plans"."target_cost_amount" is null and "product_plans"."target_cost_currency" is null) or ("product_plans"."target_cost_amount" >= 0 and "product_plans"."target_cost_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')

skus_cost_check.name: skus_cost_check
skus_cost_check.value: ("skus"."unit_cost_amount" is null and "skus"."unit_cost_currency" is null) or ("skus"."unit_cost_amount" >= 0 and "skus"."unit_cost_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')

supplier_candidates_cost_check.name: supplier_candidates_cost_check
supplier_candidates_cost_check.value: ("supplier_candidates"."quoted_cost_amount" is null and "supplier_candidates"."quoted_cost_currency" is null) or ("supplier_candidates"."quoted_cost_amount" >= 0 and "supplier_candidates"."quoted_cost_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')

channel_availability_projections_quantit.name: channel_availability_projections_quantity_check
channel_availability_projections_quantit.value: "channel_availability_projections"."priority" > 0 and "channel_availability_projections"."buffer_quantity" >= 0 and "channel_availability_projections"."allocated_quantity" >= 0 and ("channel_availability_projections"."cap_quantity" is null or "channel_availability_projections"."cap_quantity" >= 0)

advertising_metric_lines_values_check.name: advertising_metric_lines_values_check
advertising_metric_lines_values_check.value: "advertising_metric_lines"."impressions" >= 0 and "advertising_metric_lines"."clicks" >= 0 and "advertising_metric_lines"."orders" >= 0 and "advertising_metric_lines"."spend_minor" >= 0 and "advertising_metric_lines"."sales_minor" >= 0 and "advertising_metric_lines"."clicks" <= "advertising_metric_lines"."impressions" and "advertising_metric_lines"."orders" <= "advertising_metric_lines"."clicks"

customer_recommendations_review_check.name: customer_recommendations_review_check
customer_recommendations_review_check.value: ("customer_recommendations"."status" = 'pending' and "customer_recommendations"."reviewed_at" is null) or ("customer_recommendations"."status" in ('approved','rejected') and "customer_recommendations"."reviewed_at" is not null)

voc_theme_metrics_values_check.name: voc_theme_metrics_values_check
voc_theme_metrics_values_check.value: "voc_theme_metrics"."total_occurrences" >= 0 and "voc_theme_metrics"."negative_occurrences" >= 0 and "voc_theme_metrics"."negative_occurrences" <= "voc_theme_metrics"."total_occurrences" and ("voc_theme_metrics"."negative_bps" is null or "voc_theme_metrics"."negative_bps" between 0 and 10000) and "voc_theme_metrics"."weighted_score" >= 0

finance_facts_correction_check.name: finance_facts_correction_check
finance_facts_correction_check.value: ("finance_facts"."correction_kind" = 'original' and "finance_facts"."corrects_fact_id" is null) or ("finance_facts"."correction_kind" in ('reversal','replacement') and "finance_facts"."corrects_fact_id" is not null)

finance_facts_order_line_check.name: finance_facts_order_line_check
finance_facts_order_line_check.value: "finance_facts"."order_line_id" is null or "finance_facts"."order_id" is not null

finance_profit_runs_totals_check.name: finance_profit_runs_totals_check
finance_profit_runs_totals_check.value: ("finance_profit_runs"."status" = 'incomplete' and "finance_profit_runs"."revenue_minor" is null and "finance_profit_runs"."cost_minor" is null and "finance_profit_runs"."profit_minor" is null and "finance_profit_runs"."margin_bps" is null) or ("finance_profit_runs"."status" = 'complete' and "finance_profit_runs"."revenue_minor" is not null and "finance_profit_runs"."cost_minor" is not null and "finance_profit_runs"."profit_minor" is not null)

supplier_scorecard_runs_score_check.name: supplier_scorecard_runs_score_check
supplier_scorecard_runs_score_check.value: ("supplier_scorecard_runs"."status" = 'complete' and "supplier_scorecard_runs"."overall_score_bps" between 0 and 10000) or ("supplier_scorecard_runs"."status" = 'incomplete' and "supplier_scorecard_runs"."overall_score_bps" is null)

inventory_lots_cost_check.name: inventory_lots_cost_check
inventory_lots_cost_check.value: ("inventory_lots"."unit_cost_minor" is null and "inventory_lots"."unit_cost_currency" is null) or ("inventory_lots"."unit_cost_minor" >= 0 and "inventory_lots"."unit_cost_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')

inventory_lots_expiry_check.name: inventory_lots_expiry_check
inventory_lots_expiry_check.value: "inventory_lots"."expires_at" is null or "inventory_lots"."received_at" is null or "inventory_lots"."expires_at" > "inventory_lots"."received_at"

inventory_transfer_events_movements_chec.name: inventory_transfer_events_movements_check
inventory_transfer_events_movements_chec.value: (("inventory_transfer_events"."action" in ('dispatched','received')) and "inventory_transfer_events"."debit_movement_id" is not null and "inventory_transfer_events"."credit_movement_id" is not null) or (("inventory_transfer_events"."action" in ('created','cancelled')) and "inventory_transfer_events"."debit_movement_id" is null and "inventory_transfer_events"."credit_movement_id" is null)

inventory_procurement_receipt_lines_reje.name: inventory_procurement_receipt_lines_rejection_check
inventory_procurement_receipt_lines_reje.value: ("inventory_procurement_receipt_lines"."rejected_quantity" = 0 and "inventory_procurement_receipt_lines"."rejection_reason_code" is null) or ("inventory_procurement_receipt_lines"."rejected_quantity" > 0 and "inventory_procurement_receipt_lines"."rejection_reason_code" is not null)

marketplace_publication_batches_parent_c.name: marketplace_publication_batches_parent_check
marketplace_publication_batches_parent_c.value: ("marketplace_publication_batches"."action" = 'initial' and "marketplace_publication_batches"."parent_batch_id" is null) or ("marketplace_publication_batches"."action" = 'continue' and "marketplace_publication_batches"."parent_batch_id" is not null)

marketplace_publication_requests_followu.name: marketplace_publication_requests_followup_check
marketplace_publication_requests_followu.value: ("marketplace_publication_requests"."action" in ('amazon_validation_preview', 'etsy_create_draft') and "marketplace_publication_requests"."parent_request_id" is null and "marketplace_publication_requests"."source_external_listing_id" is null) or ("marketplace_publication_requests"."action" = 'amazon_submit' and "marketplace_publication_requests"."parent_request_id" is not null and "marketplace_publication_requests"."source_external_listing_id" is null and "marketplace_publication_requests"."batch_id" is null) or ("marketplace_publication_requests"."action" = 'amazon_feed_submit' and "marketplace_publication_requests"."parent_request_id" is not null and "marketplace_publication_requests"."source_external_listing_id" is null and "marketplace_publication_requests"."batch_id" is not null) or ("marketplace_publication_requests"."action" = 'etsy_activate' and "marketplace_publication_requests"."parent_request_id" is not null and "marketplace_publication_requests"."source_external_listing_id" is not null)

order_ingestion_runs_counts_check.name: order_ingestion_runs_counts_check
order_ingestion_runs_counts_check.value: "order_ingestion_runs"."collected_count" >= 0 and ("order_ingestion_runs"."reported_count" is null or "order_ingestion_runs"."reported_count" >= 0) and "order_ingestion_runs"."duplicate_count" >= 0 and "order_ingestion_runs"."risk_count" >= 0

order_line_catalog_links_target_check.name: order_line_catalog_links_target_check
order_line_catalog_links_target_check.value: "order_line_catalog_links"."sku_id" is not null or ("order_line_catalog_links"."listing_id" is not null and "order_line_catalog_links"."listing_version_id" is not null)

order_routing_decision_events_override_r.name: order_routing_decision_events_override_reason_check
order_routing_decision_events_override_r.value: "order_routing_decision_events"."type" <> 'overridden' or ("order_routing_decision_events"."supplier_id" is not null and "order_routing_decision_events"."reason_code" is not null and "order_routing_decision_events"."reason" is not null)

order_routing_decisions_selection_check.name: order_routing_decisions_selection_check
order_routing_decisions_selection_check.value: ("order_routing_decisions"."status" = 'no_eligible_supplier' and "order_routing_decisions"."selected_supplier_id" is null) or ("order_routing_decisions"."status" <> 'no_eligible_supplier' and "order_routing_decisions"."selected_supplier_id" is not null)

production_orders_parent_check.name: production_orders_parent_check
production_orders_parent_check.value: ("production_orders"."source" = 'initial' and "production_orders"."parent_production_order_id" is null) or ("production_orders"."source" = 'remake' and "production_orders"."parent_production_order_id" is not null)

production_recovery_cases_compensation_c.name: production_recovery_cases_compensation_check
production_recovery_cases_compensation_c.value: ("production_recovery_cases"."type" = 'cancellation_compensation' and "production_recovery_cases"."compensation_amount_minor" is not null and "production_recovery_cases"."compensation_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$') or ("production_recovery_cases"."type" <> 'cancellation_compensation' and "production_recovery_cases"."compensation_amount_minor" is null and "production_recovery_cases"."compensation_currency" is null)

shipment_packages_money_check.name: shipment_packages_money_check
shipment_packages_money_check.value: ("shipment_packages"."label_cost_minor" is null and "shipment_packages"."label_currency" is null) or ("shipment_packages"."label_cost_minor" >= 0 and "shipment_packages"."label_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')

shipment_packages_dimensions_check.name: shipment_packages_dimensions_check
shipment_packages_dimensions_check.value: ("shipment_packages"."length_mm" is null and "shipment_packages"."width_mm" is null and "shipment_packages"."height_mm" is null) or ("shipment_packages"."length_mm" > 0 and "shipment_packages"."width_mm" > 0 and "shipment_packages"."height_mm" > 0)

shipment_versions_delivery_check.name: shipment_versions_delivery_check
shipment_versions_delivery_check.value: ("shipment_versions"."promised_delivery_at" is null or "shipment_versions"."promised_delivery_at" >= "shipment_versions"."ship_date") and ("shipment_versions"."estimated_delivery_at" is null or "shipment_versions"."estimated_delivery_at" >= "shipment_versions"."ship_date")

after_sales_decisions_money_check.name: after_sales_decisions_money_check
after_sales_decisions_money_check.value: ("after_sales_decisions"."refund_amount_minor" is null and "after_sales_decisions"."refund_currency" is null) or ("after_sales_decisions"."refund_amount_minor" >= 0 and "after_sales_decisions"."refund_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')

fulfillment_automation_events_detail_che.name: fulfillment_automation_events_detail_check
fulfillment_automation_events_detail_che.value: ("fulfillment_automation_events"."encrypted_detail" is null and "fulfillment_automation_events"."detail_checksum" is null) or ("fulfillment_automation_events"."encrypted_detail" is not null and "fulfillment_automation_events"."detail_checksum" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')
